Let Q be the pedal curve (a limaçon of Pascal) of the circle with center X_7728 and radius \|OH\|, with respect to X_265. Let A'B'C' be the triangle formed by the tangents at A,B,C to Q. Then the triangles ABC and A'B'C' are perspective, and their perspector is X_2963. Moreover, X_21975 is the only finite fixed point of the affine transformation that maps a triangle ABC onto A'B'C'. See **X_21975** (``X_21975.png``). (Angel Montesdeoca, September 10, 2019)
